name: CombatMeter
description: Real-time party DPS/HPS meter with role colours.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Live party DPS/HPS with role colours.
History — damage timeline with navigator and per-source table.

fixed: Raid runs are recorded as one run again instead of being split into separate pieces partway through the fight.
Boss health shown in raid replays is now read straight from the game, so it stays accurate even for bosses the game never shows hitting zero.
Your own combat data now uploads reliably — every part of a run is sent even while the run's final result is still being worked out.
